name: Theme
title: Ishmael's son and ancestor of an Arab people
summary: Tema was the ninth son of Ishmael, Abraham's firstborn through Hagar. He became the ancestor of an Arab people and gave his name to an oasis and trading city in northwestern Arabia. Tema is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles, and the place Tema is referenced in several prophetic and poetic writings.

keyEvents.title: The Birth and Genealogy of Tema
keyEvents.description: Tema is listed as the ninth of Ishmael's twelve sons, all of whom became princely rulers over their peoples.

keyEvents.title: The Descendants of Ishmael in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Tema's name is repeated in the genealogy of Ishmael's sons in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Tema as a Place in the Book of Job
keyEvents.description: Caravans from Tema are mentioned in Job as an image of disappointed expectations, testifying to Tema's significance as a trading center.

keyEvents.title: The Prophecy Against Arabia and Tema in Isaiah
keyEvents.description: Isaiah prophesies about the burden upon Arabia and urges the people of Tema to meet refugees with water and bread.

keyEvents.title: Tema Mentioned in Jeremiah's Prophecy
keyEvents.description: Jeremiah mentions Tema among the Arab nations who will drink from God's cup of wrath in judgment against the nations.
